titlealts.navtitle: USE LOCAL TZ FOR UNIX TIMESTAMP CONVERSIONS

conbody.p:
USE_LOCAL_TZ_FOR_UNIX_TIMESTAMP_CONVERSIONS query option
The USE_LOCAL_TZ_FOR_UNIX_TIMESTAMP_CONVERSIONS query option selects the time zone that Impala uses when converting between Unix time and TIMESTAMP values. When it is FALSE, Impala interprets TIMESTAMP values as UTC. When it is TRUE, Impala interprets them in the local time zone.
The option affects the following functions and operations:

ul.li: The FROM_UNIXTIME(), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), and TO_TIMESTAMP() functions that take or return Unix time
CAST() from an integer, floating-point, or DECIMAL value to TIMESTAMP
CAST() from a TIMESTAMP value to an integer or floating-point type

conbody.p: The TIMEZONE query option selects the local time zone; if unset, Impala uses the coordinator's default time zone. The option does not affect timestamps read from Parquet files; see .
This option replaces the --use_local_tz_for_unix_timestamp_conversions startup flag, which is removed in .
